reviewer: Codex (visual review; not a certified property inspector)
method: Visual inspection of native RGB extracts via source/page-labeled contact sheets, selected full-resolution images and full-page renders; source text/layout reviewed for every admitted finding.

dutchdetect.modality: RGB report screenshot; no thermal images on this excerpt
dutchdetect.reason: Six small photographs embedded in a report-page screenshot; complete report and native photographs unavailable. Held outside native-photo starter; source causes, probe depths and moisture assertions are not gold.

pairing_rules.nrbi: Photo belongs to the preceding table-row heading; rows without photos remain unmatched; top-of-page continuation requires prior page.
pairing_rules.roofsignal: Explicit finding IDs and source image names link the photographed evidence; repeated photo on another finding is not independent.
pairing_rules.bijn: Heading and illustrated group continue across pages. Page 22 photos 1-5 belong to timber finding on page 21; photos 6-9 to subsequent masonry-crack observation.
pairing_rules.setelkeur: Use specific activities/findings, not general advisory paragraphs. Measurement claims remain separate from visible stain labels.
pairing_rules.veh: Match photo cell to its row; neighboring findings often have no dedicated photograph. Embedded red circle is explicitly flagged.
pairing_rules.other_reports: Check local section/row association and detailed narrative; never inherit global no-defects summary or condition rating.

negative_policy: Only one narrow, visually checked metering view is admitted as no clear visible taxonomy fault. No negative derived from missing findings.
